author: SickProdigy
description: Private text, voice, or boosted-server thread tickets with persistent controls.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores ticket destination IDs, ticket numbers, requester and staff Discord IDs, status timestamps, launcher configuration, support-role IDs, and per-member creation cooldown timestamps. Ticket message content remains in Discord channels and is not copied into Red configuration. User-data deletion anonymizes stored requester and claimant IDs and clears cooldown data; it cannot remove Discord messages or administrator-retained logs.
install_msg: Run [p]ticketsset with Manage Server to choose the launcher channel, private ticket category, and support roles, then publish the Open Ticket panel.
short: Private support tickets for members and server staff
